verification.dm_hint:
Hi! To get access to **/r/sysadmin**, run the **/verify** slash command. You can run it right here in this DM by typing `/verify`, or in any channel of the server.

If that does not work, contact <@{moderator_mail_id}> (Moderator Mail, at the top of the member list) and a moderator will help you out.
verification.not_a_member: You need to join the /r/sysadmin server before I can verify you.
verification.already_verified: You already have access to the server, so there is nothing to verify. Contact <@{moderator_mail_id}> (Moderator Mail, at the top of the member list) if something looks wrong.
verification.too_young:
Sorry, your Discord account must be at least **{required_days} days** old to be verified this way. Your account is **{account_age_days} days** old.

You can either verify with a phone number in the server, or contact <@{moderator_mail_id}> (Moderator Mail, at the top of the member list) for manual verification.
verification.success:
You have been verified. Please remember to read <#{rules_channel_id}>, and feel free to assign yourself roles in <#{roles_channel_id}>.

If you ever have an issue, do not hesitate to message <@{moderator_mail_id}> (Moderator Mail, at the top of the member list).
verification.role_missing: Verification is temporarily unavailable. Please contact <@{moderator_mail_id}> (Moderator Mail, at the top of the member list).
verification.forbidden: I could not assign your role because of a permissions problem. Please contact <@{moderator_mail_id}> (Moderator Mail, at the top of the member list).

boost.thank_you:
Thank you for boosting /r/sysadmin! As a booster you have access to a new channel (<#585867795942604800>), as well as a variety of colored roles. Check <#{roles_channel_id}> for more info on getting a colored role.

If you have any questions, feel free to message Moderator Mail (at the top of the member list).

emergency.denied: {caller}, your emergency request has been denied. Reminder that the emergency ping is reserved for business production issues that are extremely time sensitive, not for homework or any other non-emergency issue.
emergency.timed_out: The emergency request called by {caller} has timed out and was cancelled. Link: {link}
emergency.cancelled: The current emergency request has been cancelled by a moderator. The emergency command can be used again once its cooldown expires.
emergency.no_active: There is currently no active emergency request.
emergency.already_active:
There is already an active emergency request. Ask a moderator to run `/clearemergency`, or approve/deny the existing one.

Link to the current request: {link}
emergency.reminder: There is currently an emergency request awaiting approval. Link: {link} — please approve or deny it if you can.
